## Exploratory Data Analysis

This section will analyze salary trends across industries, roles, and locations to understand disparities influenced by AI.


## Load Dataset

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.builder \
    .appName("AISalaryDisparities") \
    .getOrCreate()

df = spark.read.option("header", "true") \
    .option("inferSchema", "true") \
    .option("multiLine", "true") \
    .option("escape", "\"") \
    .csv("data/lightcast_data.csv")

df.printSchema()
